redemption.name: Redemption
redemption.desc: While equipped: spend one action to restore 10% of your maximum Life, rounded down. Costs no Mana; 4-second cooldown. Only usable while injured.

details.hydraBodyValue: One body, {{heads}} heads; {{duration}} s; own Attack Speed
details.channelActionsValue: Occupied while channeling; Stun, Freeze, Paralyze or Fear interrupts
details.spellTimingValue: {{duration}} s; every {{interval}} s; {{pulses}} pulses, first immediately
details.manaBurnDrainValue: {{percent}}% of actual HP removed, rounded down; capped at MP
details.manaBurnBonusValue: +{{percent}}% direct Arcane damage while Mana Burn is active
details.selfDamageValue: {{percentOfHpRemoved}}% of actual direct HP removed (min. {{minimumLifeLoss}} HP)
details.descriptionSelfDamage: After the hit and ordinary target-death, orb and reflection effects, a surviving caster loses {{percentOfHpRemoved}}% of actual enemy HP removed (rounded down, minimum {{minimumLifeLoss}} HP, capped at remaining life). Only a hit that removes enemy HP charges this cost. This bypasses your defenses and shields and can kill you. Absorption and overkill do not count. Misses, later basic attacks and damage over time cost no life; lethal reflection cannot be reversed.
details.cone2Value: Cone: 1 cell, then 3 in the next row
details.descriptionComposite: One strike deals {{fireMin}} ~ {{fireMax}} Fire, {{coldMin}} ~ {{coldMax}} Cold and {{lightningMin}} ~ {{lightningMax}} Lightning base damage. The components share one hit and critical roll, with separate modifiers and mitigation. Fire applies Burn, Cold applies Chill for {{chillSeconds}} s and Lightning applies Paralyze for {{paralyzeSeconds}} s; repeated Paralyze can fail. A miss applies none.
details.descriptionComponentBurn: Burn uses only the Fire component after mitigation: {{percentOfHit}}% per second per stack (rounded down, minimum {{minDps}}) for {{durationSeconds}} s, up to {{maxStacks}} stacks. Refreshing adds a stack and extends duration; an existing damaging Burn keeps its original rate.
details.descriptionPeriodic: On a successful hit, each {{status}} stack deals {{percentOfHit}}% of the final hit per second (rounded down, minimum {{minDps}}) for {{durationSeconds}} s, up to {{maxStacks}} stacks. Reapplying refreshes duration and adds a stack up to the cap; an existing damaging status keeps its original rate.
details.descriptionBurn: On a successful hit, Burn deals {{percentOfHit}}% of the final hit per second per stack (rounded down, minimum {{minDps}}) for {{durationSeconds}} s, up to {{maxStacks}} stacks. Refreshing adds a stack and extends duration; an existing damaging Burn keeps its original rate.
details.treeSummary: Hover, focus, or tap a node to preview its current and next-level power.
details.currentEmpty: Spend a point to unlock current stats.
details.descriptionSummonPreparation: {{skill}}: once at each wave start, if learned, unlocked and in your combo, fill missing living summons up to {{count}} for one payment of {{mana}} MP for the whole batch. Already full: no cost. Not enough mana: no summons or payment, and no retry that wave. This skill uses no ordinary action; fallen summons are not replaced and return no mana. Each new wave starts with fresh summons, paid from your carried mana.
details.descriptionRecovery: After its direct hit and ordinary death/reflection effects, a living caster restores {{percentOfHpRemoved}}% of actual enemy HP removed (rounded down, capped at missing life). Absorbed damage and overkill do not count. No healing from later basic attacks or damage over time; lethal reflection cannot be reversed.
details.descriptionFeralSpeed: Each Feral hit that removes enemy HP adds {{percentPerStack}}% self attack speed, up to {{maxStacks}} additive stacks, and refreshes all stacks for {{durationSeconds}} s, including at the cap or full life. Remaining duration carries between waves. Losing valid allocation, prerequisites or active priority clears speed on the next wave or explicit configuration replay. Fresh runs/imports start without stacks.
details.descriptionDruidSummon: Different summon templates coexist. Special effects require the living original owner; the rows show base rank stats before temporary allied buffs.
details.descriptionPeriodicMultiple: On a successful hit, applies {{stacksOnApply}} {{status}} stacks. Each stack deals {{percentOfHit}}% of the final hit per second (rounded down, minimum {{minDps}}) for {{durationSeconds}} s, up to {{maxStacks}} stacks. Reapplying refreshes duration and adds {{stacksOnApply}} stacks up to the cap; an existing damaging status keeps its original rate.
details.cone3Value: Cone: 1, 3, then 5 cells across three rows

magic-arrow.name: Magic Arrow
magic-arrow.desc: One single-target attempt deals {{min}}–{{max}} Arcane base damage. Arcane resistance and magic resist apply. Requires a bow or crossbow; uses no ammunition. Pay {{mana}} MP with a {{cooldown}} s cooldown.

multiple-shot.name: Multiple Shot
multiple-shot.desc: One independent Physical attack attempt at each of up to {{maxTargets}} living enemies in a three-row widening cone (1, 3, then 5 cells), dealing {{min}}–{{max}} base damage per attempt. Misses consume attempts; Physical resistance and Defense apply. Pay {{mana}} MP once with a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Sparse cones do not select enemies outside the footprint.

freezing-arrow.name: Freezing Arrow
freezing-arrow.desc: Hits enemies in a 3×3 area with Cold damage. Each landed target receives Chill for {{chillSeconds}} seconds (half attack speed), then independently has a {{chance}}% chance of Freeze for {{freezeSeconds}} second ({{bossSeconds}} seconds for bosses and chapter bosses). Chance and duration do not scale with rank.

lightning-fury.name: Lightning Fury
lightning-fury.desc: Chain through every original living enemy, starting at target priority and then the nearest grid neighbor. Each receives one independent Lightning attempt for {{min}}–{{max}} base damage; landed hits apply {{paralyzeSeconds}} s Paralyze. Pay {{mana}} MP once; {{cooldown}} s cooldown.

plague-javelin.name: Plague Javelin
plague-javelin.desc: One attempt at each of up to three living enemies in one row deals {{min}}–{{max}} Poison base damage. Poison resistance and Defense apply; magic resist does not. Each landed hit applies {{stacks}} Poison stacks for {{poisonSeconds}} s ({{poisonPercent}}% of the final hit per second, maximum {{cap}} stacks; active Poison keeps its original rate), plus Plague for {{plagueSeconds}} s. Plague adds no extra periodic damage. On death, {{ordinaryPercent}}% of current Poison stacks spread to all its living allies (rounded down, at least one), keeping the captured rate for a fresh {{poisonSeconds}} s. If a target already has {{threshold}} active Poison stacks before the cast, its death while Plague is active spreads {{epidemicPercent}}% instead, once per cast. Pay {{mana}} MP with a {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast. Misses apply neither status.

strafe.name: Strafe
strafe.desc: {{strikes}} ordered passes across all original living enemies; each target gets up to {{strikes}} independent Physical attempts for {{min}}–{{max}} base damage each. Misses consume attempts; dead originals are skipped without redistributing attempts. Stop on caster death. Physical resistance and Defense apply. Pay {{mana}} MP once with a {{cooldown}} s cooldown.

critical-strike.name: Critical Strike
critical-strike.desc: Automatically adds {{bonus}} percentage point of critical hit chance per allocated rank (maximum {{cap}} ranks).

penetrate.name: Penetrate
penetrate.desc: Automatically increases your equipment-derived Attack by {{bonus}}% per allocated rank (maximum {{cap}} ranks).

dodge.name: Dodge
dodge.desc: Automatically adds {{bonus}} percentage point of physical dodge chance per allocated rank (maximum {{cap}} ranks).

valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
valkyrie.desc: Summons a Valkyrie warrior to fight at your side.

fire-arrow.name: Fire Arrow
fire-arrow.desc: One single-target attempt deals {{min}}–{{max}} Fire base damage. Fire resistance and Defense apply. A landed hit applies Burn. Pay {{mana}} MP with a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Misses apply no Burn.

cold-arrow.name: Cold Arrow
cold-arrow.desc: One single-target attempt deals {{min}}–{{max}} Cold base damage. Cold resistance and magic resist apply. A landed hit applies Chill for {{chillSeconds}} s, reducing attack speed by {{slowPercent}}%; it refreshes without stacking. Pay {{mana}} MP with a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Misses apply no Chill.

exploding-arrow.name: Exploding Arrow
exploding-arrow.desc: A 3×3 explosion makes one independent Fire attempt at each of up to {{maxTargets}} living enemies for {{min}}–{{max}} base damage. Landed hits apply Burn. Pay {{mana}} MP once; {{cooldown}} s cooldown.

ice-arrow.name: Ice Arrow
ice-arrow.desc: One single-target attempt deals {{min}}–{{max}} Cold base damage. Cold resistance and magic resist apply. A landed hit applies Freeze for {{freeze}} (bosses: {{bossFreeze}}), then Chill for {{chill}}, reducing attack speed by {{slowPercent}}%. Reapplication refreshes duration without stacking. Pay {{mana}} MP with a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Misses apply neither status.

guided-arrow.name: Guided Arrow
guided-arrow.desc: One guaranteed single-target Physical hit deals {{min}}–{{max}} base damage. Ignores ordinary accuracy, dodge and Blind; Physical resistance, Defense, critical hits and personal absorption still apply. Pay {{mana}} MP with a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. A lethal hit does not switch targets.

immolation-arrow.name: Immolation Arrow
immolation-arrow.desc: A 3×3 explosion makes one independent Fire attempt at each of up to {{maxTargets}} living enemies for {{min}}–{{max}} base damage. The pyre leaves Burn on struck foes. Pay {{mana}} MP once; {{cooldown}} s cooldown.

jab.name: Jab
jab.desc: Up to {{strikes}} independent Physical attack attempts against the original target, dealing {{min}}–{{max}} damage per attempt. Misses consume attempts. Stop when the original target or caster dies; do not switch to another enemy. Pay mana and start cooldown once per cast.

power-strike.name: Power Strike
power-strike.desc: One single-target attempt deals {{min}}–{{max}} base damage in equal Physical and Lightning shares, with one shared hit and critical decision. On landing, release up to {{bolts}} additional Lightning attempts at the same original target, each for {{boltMin}}–{{boltMax}} Lightning base damage. Dead originals are skipped; no spill. Physical resistance and Defense apply to the Physical share; Lightning resistance and magic resist apply to Lightning. Pay {{mana}} MP once with a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Stop on caster death.

poison-javelin.name: Poison Javelin
poison-javelin.desc: One independent attempt at each of up to {{maxTargets}} living enemies in a 3×3 impact cloud deals {{min}}–{{max}} base damage as Poison. Poison resistance and Defense apply. Each landed hit applies Poison for {{poisonSeconds}} s at {{poisonPercent}}% of the final hit per second (rounded down, minimum1), up to {{poisonCap}} stacks. Reapplication adds one stack and refreshes duration; active Poison keeps its original rate and any longer expiry. Pay {{mana}} MP once with a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. The cloud does not acquire later spawns.

impale.name: Impale
impale.desc: Thrust at one enemy for {{min}}–{{max}} Physical damage, ignoring ordinary Defense; resistance and dodge still apply. A successful hit inflicts Bleed.

lightning-bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning-bolt.desc: One single-target attempt deals {{min}}–{{max}} Lightning base damage. Lightning resistance and magic resist apply. Pay {{mana}} MP with a {{cooldown}} s cooldown.

charged-strike.name: Charged Strike
charged-strike.desc: One single-target attempt deals {{min}}–{{max}} base damage as Lightning. On landing, up to {{bolts}} other original living hostiles in the cross around the primary each receive one independent Lightning bolt for {{boltMin}}–{{boltMax}} Lightning base damage. Lightning resistance and magic resist apply. Misses consume attempts; dead selections are skipped without replacements or outside fill. Pay {{mana}} MP once with a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Stop on caster death.

fend.name: Fend
fend.desc: Strike up to {{maxTargets}} living enemies in a cross, once each, for {{min}}–{{max}} Physical base damage. Pay {{mana}} MP once; {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Misses consume attempts.

lightning-strike.name: Lightning Strike
lightning-strike.desc: One independent Lightning attempt at each of up to {{maxTargets}} distinct original living enemies deals {{min}}–{{max}} base damage. Start at target priority, then choose the nearest Manhattan neighbor, retaining priority on ties. Lightning resistance and magic resist apply. Each landed hit applies {{paralyzeSeconds}} s Paralyze. Misses consume attempts; no sixth replacement or repeated target. Pay {{mana}} MP once with a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Stop on caster death.

inner-sight.name: Inner Sight
inner-sight.desc: Reduces all living enemies’ ordinary Defense by {{reduction}}% for {{duration}}. This improves direct Physical, Fire, Poison and Thorns damage; hit chance, dodge, resistances, Magic Resist and existing damage-over-time rates stay unchanged. With the Rogue effect, the stronger Inner Sight applies once. Pay {{mana}} MP; {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Reapplication replaces the interval.

slow-missiles.name: Slow Missiles
slow-missiles.desc: Slows all living enemies’ projectiles, including shots already in flight, to {{speed}}% normal speed for {{duration}}. Melee and enemy attack cadence stay unchanged. Damage and defenses resolve on impact. Pay {{mana}} MP; {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Reapplication refreshes the window.

avoid.name: Avoid
avoid.desc: Automatically adds {{magicDodge}} percentage point to magical dodge per allocated rank. Amazon only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave.

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.desc: At each wave start, pay {{mana}} MP to create one non-attacking Decoy with {{life}} Life for {{duration}}. Enemies aim single-target attacks at it; Taunt takes priority. Area attacks can still hit you. No replacement or mana refund that wave. If mana is insufficient, it is not retried until the next wave. {{cooldown}} s cooldown.

evade.name: Evade
evade.desc: Automatically adds {{physicalDodge}} percentage point to physical dodge and {{magicDodge}} percentage point to magical dodge per allocated rank. Amazon only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave.

pierce.name: Pierce
pierce.desc: Automatically increases direct physical damage by {{damage}}% and equipment-derived Attack by {{attack}}% per allocated rank. Attack bonuses add with Penetrate. Amazon only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave.

shock-web.name: Shock Web
shock-web.desc: Lays a web of crackling lightning that paralyzes all enemies in combat.

fire-blast.name: Fire Blast
fire-blast.desc: Throws a fire trap that explodes once for {{min}} ~ {{max}} Fire damage per enemy in a two-row cone: one apex cell, then three adjacent cells in the next row. Chooses the cone with the most enemies, breaking ties by the foremost row then leftmost column. Each hit rolls separately and can apply Burn.

blade-fury.name: Blade Fury
blade-fury.desc: Hurls a spread of blades for {{min}} ~ {{max}} Physical damage per enemy in a two-row cone: one apex cell, then three adjacent cells in the next row. Chooses the cone with the most enemies, breaking ties by the foremost row then leftmost column. Each enemy rolls separately. Mana and cooldown are paid once per cast.

mind-blast.name: Mind Blast
mind-blast.desc: Deals {{min}} ~ {{max}} Arcane damage to every enemy. Each landed hit applies Mana Burn then Stun for {{seconds}} second ({{bossSeconds}} seconds on bosses). Drain {{drain}}% of actual HP removed after shields, rounded down and capped at remaining MP. Mana Burn lasts until mana is restored. While marked at zero MP before a hit, take {{bonus}}% more direct Arcane damage in addition to existing combos. Affected monsters at zero MP can use basic attacks but cannot use skills. Pay 30 MP and start one 3 s cooldown per cast.

dragon-claw.name: Dragon Claw
dragon-claw.desc: Up to {{strikes}} independent Physical claw attempts against the original target, {{min}} ~ {{max}} base damage per attempt, with +{{critical}} percentage points of critical chance per attempt. Misses consume attempts; stop if the original target or caster dies. Pay 20 MP and start the 1 s cooldown once per cast. Defense, resistance, absorption and reflection apply to each attempt; weapon Attack adds no damage.

phoenix-strike.name: Phoenix Strike
phoenix-strike.desc: A combo strike that releases fire, cold, and lightning charges on a single target.

claw-mastery.name: Claw Mastery
claw-mastery.desc: Automatically active with a one-handed claw in the main weapon slot. Each rank adds {{attack}}% Attack and {{critical}} percentage points of critical chance; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

weapon-block.name: Weapon Block
weapon-block.desc: Automatically active with two distinct one-handed weapons and learned Claw Mastery. Each rank adds {{physicalDodge}} percentage points of physical dodge and {{magicDodge}} percentage points of magical dodge; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

fade.name: Fade
fade.desc: Automatically active for the Assassin. Each rank adds {{resist}} resistance points to all six damage types and {{magicDodge}} percentage points of magical dodge; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

venom.name: Venom
venom.desc: Automatically active for the Assassin. Each rank adds {{poison}}% poison damage. Each successful basic hit applies one poison stack for {{seconds}} seconds: {{coating}}% Attack per second, increased by poison damage bonuses, then reduced by poison resistance and armor; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

tiger-strike.name: Tiger Strike
tiger-strike.desc: First charge-up strike that adds damage.

dragon-talon.name: Dragon Talon
dragon-talon.desc: Up to {{strikes}} independent Physical kick attempts against the original target, dealing {{min}}–{{max}} damage per attempt. Misses consume attempts. Stop when the original target or caster dies; do not switch to another enemy. Pay mana and start cooldown once per cast.

cobra-strike.name: Cobra Strike
cobra-strike.desc: Charge-up attack that steals life and mana.

dragon-tail.name: Dragon Tail
dragon-tail.desc: An explosive kick that hits multiple enemies.

dragon-flight.name: Dragon Flight
dragon-flight.desc: Teleports to an enemy and kicks them.

psychic-hammer.name: Psychic Hammer
psychic-hammer.desc: Psychic force deals {{min}} ~ {{max}} Arcane base damage to one enemy. A landed hit applies Stun for {{duration}} (bosses: {{bossDuration}}). This control effect interrupts actions without moving the target. Misses apply no Stun. Rank changes apply next wave.

burst-of-speed.name: Burst of Speed
burst-of-speed.desc: A paid cast grants +{{speed}}% Attack Speed and +{{dodge}} percentage points of physical dodge per rank for {{seconds}} seconds. Put this skill in active priority. It cannot refresh while active; after expiry it can cast again if mana and cooldown allow. Allocation changes apply next wave; a paid effect keeps its cast rank. Unlocks at level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks.

cloak-of-shadows.name: Cloak of Shadows
cloak-of-shadows.desc: A paid cast Blinds all current enemies for {{seconds}} seconds and grants you +{{defense}}% Defense, +{{critical}} percentage points of critical chance and +{{dodge}} percentage points of magical dodge per rank for the same duration. Blind lowers Physical/thorns hit probability by {{penalty}} percentage points (minimum 5%); it does not stop actions or affect magical attacks. Put Cloak in active priority. It cannot refresh while active. Allocation changes apply next wave; a paid effect keeps its cast rank.

shadow-warrior.name: Shadow Warrior
shadow-warrior.desc: Summons a shadow copy that uses your skills.

shadow-master.name: Shadow Master
shadow-master.desc: Summons an advanced shadow that uses skills independently.

charged-bolt-sentry.name: Charged Bolt Sentry
charged-bolt-sentry.desc: Deploys a trap that fires charged bolts.

blade-sentinel.name: Blade Sentinel
blade-sentinel.desc: Releases a spinning blade that patrols the area.

lightning-sentry.name: Lightning Sentry
lightning-sentry.desc: Deploys a trap that shoots lightning.

wake-of-inferno.name: Wake of Inferno
wake-of-inferno.desc: Lays traps that release streams of fire.

death-sentry.name: Death Sentry
death-sentry.desc: Deploys a trap that shoots lightning and explodes corpses.

blade-shield.name: Blade Shield
blade-shield.desc: Surrounds you with spinning blades that damage attackers.

bash.name: Bash
bash.desc: One single-target {{min}}–{{max}} Physical base-damage attempt. Physical bonuses, critical hits, Defense and Physical resistance apply normally. Pay {{mana}} MP and start the {{cooldown}} s cooldown once. Changes apply next wave.

double-swing.name: Double Swing
double-swing.desc: Two cleaving passes over the same up to {{maxTargets}} living enemies in the densest cross. Ties choose the lowest row then column; targets are ordered by row, then column. Each original target gets up to {{strikes}} independent attempts, {{min}}–{{max}} Physical base damage per attempt. Misses consume attempts; skip dead originals without replacements or redistributing their attempts. Stop if the caster dies. Pay 10 MP and start the 1 s cooldown once per cast. Rank changes apply next wave.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: One independent attempt per living enemy, each dealing {{min}}–{{max}} Physical base damage. Each target rolls hit and critical separately; Physical bonuses, Defense, resistance and shared status combos apply normally. Pay {{mana}} MP and start the {{cooldown}} s cooldown once. Changes apply next wave.

leap-attack.name: Leap Attack
leap-attack.desc: One independent attempt per living enemy, each dealing {{min}}–{{max}} Physical base damage. Successful hits apply Stun for {{duration}} (bosses: {{bossDuration}}), interrupting scheduled actions. Misses do not stun. Pay {{mana}} MP and start the {{cooldown}} s cooldown once. Changes apply next wave.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.desc: One {{min}}–{{max}} base-damage attempt plus {{attack}}% of Attack, converting the entire hit as Arcane. Arcane modifiers and magical defenses apply; Physical damage bonuses, Defense and Physical resistance do not. Pay 20 MP and start the 2 s cooldown once. Changes apply next wave.

war-cry.name: War Cry
war-cry.desc: One independent attempt per living enemy, each dealing {{min}}–{{max}} Physical base damage. Successful hits apply Stun for {{duration}} (bosses: {{bossDuration}}), interrupting scheduled actions. Misses do not stun. Pay {{mana}} MP and start the {{cooldown}} s cooldown once. Changes apply next wave.

iron-skin.name: Iron Skin
iron-skin.desc: Passive: +{{bonus}}% ordinary defense per allocated skill rank (up to +{{maxBonus}}% at rank {{cap}}). Unlocks at character level {{level}}.

natural-resistance.name: Natural Resistance
natural-resistance.desc: Automatically adds {{resist}} percentage points to all six resistances and {{magicDodge}} percentage points to magical dodge per allocated rank. Barbarian only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks.

battle-orders.name: Battle Orders
battle-orders.desc: Automatically adds {{life}}% maximum Life and {{recovery}}% ordinary Energy-based Mana Regeneration per allocated rank. Barbarian only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Life bonuses add with Increased Stamina; item recovery then scales the recovery rate. Maximum mana is unchanged. Applies to the hero only. Learning or resetting applies next wave; extra capacity does not heal or refill.

shout.name: Shout
shout.desc: Automatically adds {{defense}}% ordinary Defense per allocated rank. Barbarian only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Adds with Iron Skin over fresh equipment Defense. Applies to the hero only. Learning or resetting applies next wave; current HP and MP are preserved.

leap.name: Leap
leap.desc: Applies Stun for {{stun}} to all living enemies (bosses: {{bossStun}}), without moving them. Increases your direct Physical damage by {{bonus}}% for {{duration}}. Leap deals no direct damage and cannot be recast while its personal bonus is active. Rank changes apply next wave.

stun.name: Stun
stun.desc: One {{min}}–{{max}} Physical base-damage attempt. Successful hits apply Stun for {{duration}} (bosses: {{bossDuration}}), interrupting scheduled actions. Misses do not stun. Pay 8 MP and start the 2 s cooldown once. Changes apply next wave.

double-throw.name: Double Throw
double-throw.desc: {{strikes}} total independent throws rotate among the first two living enemies, enemy summons first, then battle order. {{min}}–{{max}} Physical base damage per attempt. A lone original can receive both throws. Misses consume attempts; skip dead originals and continue on surviving originals. Never select enemies outside the original pool. Stop if the caster or the entire pool dies. Pay 12 MP and start the 1 s cooldown once per cast. Rank changes apply next wave.

concentrate.name: Concentrate
concentrate.desc: One {{min}}–{{max}} Physical base-damage attempt. The paid cast increases your Defense by {{defense}}% for {{duration}}, even if the attack misses. It never stacks or extends an active stance. Pay 10 MP and start the 1 s cooldown once. Changes apply next wave; paid Defense lasts until expiry.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.desc: {{strikes}} independent attempts against the same original enemy, {{min}}–{{max}} Physical base damage per attempt. Each damaging hit grants {{percent}}% attack speed, up to {{cap}} stacks, and refreshes all stacks for {{seconds}} s. Misses and hits that remove no HP grant no stacks. Stop if the caster or original target dies; no replacement. Basic attacks benefit from active speed but never refresh it. Pay 12 MP and start the 1 s cooldown once per cast. Rank and priority changes apply next wave; unconfiguring Frenzy removes carried speed next wave.

sword-mastery.name: Sword Mastery
sword-mastery.desc: Automatically active for a Barbarian with a sword in the weapon slot. Each rank adds {{physical}}% direct physical damage and {{critical}} percentage points of critical chance; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

axe-mastery.name: Axe Mastery
axe-mastery.desc: Automatically active for a Barbarian with an axe in the weapon slot. Each rank adds {{physical}}% direct physical damage and {{critical}} percentage points of critical chance; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

mace-mastery.name: Mace Mastery
mace-mastery.desc: Automatically active for a Barbarian with a mace in the weapon slot. Each rank adds {{physical}}% direct physical damage and {{critical}} percentage points of critical chance; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

pole-arm-mastery.name: Pole Arm Mastery
pole-arm-mastery.desc: Automatically adds {{physical}}% physical damage and {{critical}} percentage points of critical chance per rank while a polearm is equipped in the weapon slot. Unlocks at level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks. Changes apply from the next wave.

throwing-mastery.name: Throwing Mastery
throwing-mastery.desc: Automatically adds {{physical}}% physical damage and {{speed}}% attack speed per rank while a throwing weapon is equipped in the weapon slot. Unlocks at level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks. Changes apply from the next wave.

spear-mastery.name: Spear Mastery
spear-mastery.desc: Automatically adds {{physical}}% physical damage and {{critical}} percentage points of critical chance per rank while a spear is equipped in the weapon slot. Unlocks at level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks. Changes apply from the next wave.

increased-stamina.name: Increased Stamina
increased-stamina.desc: Automatically increases equipment-derived combat maximum life by {{life}}% per allocated rank. Barbarian only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Learning does not heal during an encounter.

increased-speed.name: Increased Speed
increased-speed.desc: Automatically increases equipment-derived attack speed by {{speed}}% and adds {{physicalDodge}} percentage points to physical dodge per allocated rank. Barbarian only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks.

howl.name: Howl
howl.desc: Fear interrupts scheduled actions of every living enemy for {{duration}} (bosses: {{bossDuration}}). No movement or damage. Pay {{mana}} MP and start the {{cooldown}} s cooldown once. Reapplication replaces the interval. Changes apply next wave.

find-potion.name: Find Potion
find-potion.desc: Consumes one shared enemy corpse to restore {{life}}% of your maximum life and {{manaRecovery}}% of maximum mana, rounded down and capped. Pay {{mana}} MP first; cooldown {{cooldown}} s. Creates no potion item. With no corpse, or no life or net mana gain, skip to the next skill or basic attack. Changes apply next wave.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Forces one enemy to target its living caster with basic and single-target hostile attacks for {{duration}}. If the caster dies or becomes ineligible, ordinary targeting resumes. Area attacks keep their targets. Pay {{mana}} MP and start the {{cooldown}} s cooldown once. Reapplication replaces the source and interval. Changes apply next wave.

find-item.name: Find Item
find-item.desc: Consumes one shared enemy corpse for a {{chance}}% chance of an extra ordinary loot roll from that monster, collected on wave victory with no extra XP or quest credit. Pay {{mana}} MP; cooldown {{cooldown}} s. Failure still consumes the corpse, mana and cooldown. A successful roll may yield no item; defeat or flee loses uncollected loot. With no corpse, skip to the next skill or basic attack. Changes apply next wave.

battle-cry.name: Battle Cry
battle-cry.desc: Reduces every living enemy’s outgoing direct damage by {{damageReduction}}% and ordinary Defense by {{defenseReduction}}% for {{duration}}. Resistances, Magic Resist, existing periodic damage and reflection are unchanged. Pay {{mana}} MP and start the {{cooldown}} s cooldown once. Reapplication replaces potency and interval. Changes apply next wave; paid potency lasts until expiry.

grim-ward.name: Grim Ward
grim-ward.desc: Spend {{mana}} MP and one shared enemy corpse to raise a ward for {{duration}}s. Immediately and every {{interval}}s, frighten current enemies for {{fear}}s (bosses: {{boss}}s), interrupting their actions. Only one active ward per caster; it deals no damage and cannot be attacked. Ends when its caster dies or this wave ends. Cooldown: {{cooldown}}s. Changed learning applies next wave.

battle-command.name: Battle Command
battle-command.desc: Spend {{mana}} MP to grant yourself and current living allies +{{bonus}} to already-learned skills for {{duration}}. Permanent allocations stay unchanged; this does not stack or refresh, and the caster cannot recast while active. Later arrivals receive no bonus. The remaining duration carries between waves; source death preserves it, recipient death ends it, and a fresh challenge clears it. Cooldown: {{cooldown}} s. Learning changes apply next wave.

firestorm.name: Firestorm
firestorm.desc: Summons a storm of fire that strikes all enemies and applies burn.

arctic-blast.name: Arctic Blast
arctic-blast.desc: One Cold hit deals {{min}}–{{max}} damage to enemies in the best cross on their grid and applies Chill for {{duration}}. The cross covers its center and four neighboring cells; it does not hit the entire field.

tornado.name: Tornado
tornado.desc: One Physical hit deals {{min}}–{{max}} damage to enemies in the best horizontal three-cell line. This is one area attack with no additional control effect.

summon-dire-wolf.name: Summon Dire Wolf
summon-dire-wolf.desc: Dire wolves fight with ordinary Physical attacks. Ranks increase their life, Attack and defense, and the displayed summon cap.

werewolf-maul.name: Werewolf: Maul
werewolf-maul.desc: A single Physical hit deals {{min}}–{{max}} damage and applies Bleed. Usable in any form after learning Werebear; this attack preserves your current form. Werewolf and Werebear are separate paid skills.

hurricane.name: Hurricane
hurricane.desc: One Cold pulse deals {{min}}–{{max}} damage to all living enemies and applies Chill for {{duration}}. Each cast pulses once.

elemental-mastery.name: Elemental Mastery
elemental-mastery.desc: Automatically increases fire and cold damage by {{elemental}}% and adds {{dodge}} percentage point to magical dodge per allocated rank. Druid only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave.

lycanthropy.name: Lycanthropy
lycanthropy.desc: Automatic only while in paid werewolf form: gain {{life}}% maximum life and {{speed}}% attack speed per allocated rank, added to Werewolf bonuses. No effect in human or bear form. Druid level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks. Changes apply next wave; increased life capacity never heals you.

heart-of-wolverine.name: Heart of Wolverine
heart-of-wolverine.desc: Automatic allied aura: each allocated rank adds {{attack}}% Attack and {{critical}} percentage point critical chance to you, your original fielded mercenary and your living summons. Requires learned Oak Sage and Druid level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks. Attack affects basic attacks and Attack-scaled skill portions; fixed skill damage stays independent. Effects end when the source dies. Changes apply next wave.

oak-sage.name: Oak Sage
oak-sage.desc: Automatic allied aura: each allocated rank adds {{life}}% life capacity to you, your original fielded mercenary and your living summons. Druid level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks. Increased capacity never heals; form and aura bonuses add over the same base. Effects end when the source dies. Learning and allocation changes apply next wave.

molten-boulder.name: Molten Boulder
molten-boulder.desc: Rolls a boulder of lava that burns enemies in its path.

fissure.name: Fissure
fissure.desc: Opens a volcanic fissure that erupts with flame.

cyclone-armor.name: Cyclone Armor
cyclone-armor.desc: Paid once per run: each rank reduces post-mitigation damage by {{reduction}}% and adds {{resistance}} point to all six resistances. At rank {{cap}}, reduction is {{maxReduction}}%. Applies to direct damage, reflected Thorns and damage over time; this broad protection is provisional tuning. Carries across waves without another payment and does not heal or refill resources. Learned-rank or prerequisite changes apply next wave; losing eligibility removes protection. New runs and imports start unpaid. Requires level {{level}} and Arctic Blast.

twister.name: Twister
twister.desc: One Physical hit deals {{min}}–{{max}} damage to the first two prioritized enemies and applies Stun for {{duration}} ({{bossDuration}} against bosses).

volcano.name: Volcano
volcano.desc: Creates a volcano that spews fire.

armageddon.name: Armageddon
armageddon.desc: Calls down meteors from the sky.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.desc: Paid cast: transform into a werewolf, gaining {{speed}}% attack speed and {{dodge}} percentage point physical dodge per rank. Druid level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks. The first eligible form in your active priority is chosen; it carries between waves without recasting. Changing the chosen form requires another paid cast. Learning, removing or reordering forms applies next wave. Increased life capacity never heals you.

werebear.name: Werebear
werebear.desc: Paid cast: transform into a bear, gaining {{life}}% maximum life and {{defense}}% defense per rank. Requires learned Lycanthropy and Druid level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks. The first eligible form in your active priority is chosen; forms cannot stack and carry between waves without recasting. Changes apply next wave; changing form requires another paid cast. Increased life capacity never heals you. Lycanthropy bonuses apply only in wolf form.

feral-rage.name: Feral Rage
feral-rage.desc: A single Physical hit deals {{min}}–{{max}} damage, applies Bleed, restores life and builds self attack speed. Works in any form; learned Werewolf is required, without a separately paid transformation.

maul.name: Maul
maul.desc: A powerful bear attack that stuns the target.

rabies.name: Rabies
rabies.desc: A single Poison hit deals {{min}}–{{max}} damage and applies Poison. On death while Poison remains active, half the stacks (rounded down, minimum one) spread to every living enemy on the same side, retaining their damage rate for a fresh 5 s. Further deaths can continue the chain.

fire-claws.name: Fire Claws
fire-claws.desc: A single Fire hit deals {{min}}–{{max}} damage and applies Burn. Each cast attacks once; it does not enchant later basic attacks.

hunger.name: Hunger
hunger.desc: A single Physical hit deals {{min}}–{{max}} damage and restores life from actual enemy HP removed. Works in any form; learned Feral Rage and its prerequisites are required, without a separately paid transformation. Does not recover mana.

shock-wave.name: Shock Wave
shock-wave.desc: One Physical hit deals {{min}}–{{max}} damage to all living enemies and applies Stun for {{duration}} ({{bossDuration}} against bosses). Works in any form after learning Maul and its prerequisites; preserves your current form.

fury.name: Fury
fury.desc: Up to {{strikes}} independent Physical attack attempts, each dealing {{min}}–{{max}} damage. Rotate within the original two-enemy pool; a lone survivor can take every remaining attempt. Stop when the pool is defeated or the caster dies. Pay mana and start cooldown once per cast. Works in any form after learning Rabies and its prerequisites; preserves your current form.

raven.name: Raven
raven.desc: Ravens make ordinary Physical attacks. A landed hit applies Blind for {{durationSeconds}} s, reducing ordinary Physical and thorns hit chance by {{hitPenaltyPoints}} percentage points, with the existing 5% minimum. Repeated hits refresh one Blind; bosses keep its full duration. Blind does not affect magical hits or attack speed.

poison-creeper.name: Poison Creeper
poison-creeper.desc: The creeper keeps its ordinary Physical hit and applies Poison: each stack deals {{percentOfHit}}% of the final mitigated hit per second (rounded down, minimum {{minDps}}), for {{durationSeconds}} s, up to {{maxStacks}} stacks. Repeated hits refresh duration and add a stack up to the cap; an existing damaging status keeps its original rate. Misses apply no Poison.

summon-spirit-wolf.name: Summon Spirit Wolf
summon-spirit-wolf.desc: Spirit wolves fight with ordinary Physical attacks. Ranks increase their life, Attack and defense, and the displayed summon cap.

carrion-vine.name: Carrion Vine
carrion-vine.desc: On its scheduled action, the vine consumes the oldest eligible monster corpse to restore {{percentOfOwnerMax}}% of its living owner’s current maximum life, rounded down and capped by missing life. Recovery replaces its scheduled attack. The corpse pool is shared with corpse explosions, Redemption and other vines. With full life, no corpse, a dead owner or zero recovery it consumes nothing; an eligible vine attacks normally instead. Stun, Freeze and Paralyze prevent recovery. Corpses do not carry between waves.

solar-creeper.name: Solar Creeper
solar-creeper.desc: On its scheduled action, the vine consumes the oldest eligible monster corpse to restore {{percentOfOwnerMax}}% of its living owner’s current maximum mana, rounded down and capped by missing mana. Recovery replaces its scheduled attack. The corpse pool is shared with corpse explosions, Redemption and other vines. With full mana, no corpse, a dead owner or zero recovery it consumes nothing; an eligible vine attacks normally instead. Stun, Freeze and Paralyze prevent recovery. Corpses do not carry between waves.

spirit-of-barbs.name: Spirit of Barbs
spirit-of-barbs.desc: At each wave start, automatically creates one targetable support spirit with no ordinary action, mana cost or combo slot. It never attacks and is not replaced after death that wave. While both you and the spirit live, each allocated rank reflects {{thorns}}% of physical Life actually lost by you, your original fielded mercenary and your living summons if the hit is survived; adds {{defense}}% Defense only to your summons, including the spirit. Reflection is mitigated as thorns and cannot reflect again. Requires learned Heart of Wolverine and Oak Sage, Druid level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks. Changes apply next wave. Preview shows base stats before combat bonuses, including Oak Sage and this Defense aura; increased life capacity never heals.

summon-grizzly.name: Summon Grizzly
summon-grizzly.desc: One grizzly fights with ordinary Physical attacks. Ranks increase its life, Attack and defense; the cap stays one.

raise-skeleton.name: Raise Skeleton
raise-skeleton.desc: Prepare skeleton warriors; no corpse is required.

corpse-explosion.name: Corpse Explosion
corpse-explosion.desc: Requires an enemy monster to die in this wave first. Consumes one shared corpse and {{mana}} MP to deal {{min}}–{{max}} {{type}} damage to all remaining enemies and apply {{ignite}} on hit. Cooldown: {{cooldown}}. With no corpse, the combo skips this skill. Corpses clear between waves; consumption leaves normal kill rewards unchanged.

poison-nova.name: Poison Nova
poison-nova.desc: One independent attempt against every living enemy, including separated and overflow targets, for {{min}}–{{max}} Poison base damage. Poison resistance and Defense mitigate each direct hit; magic resist does not. Misses apply no Poison. Pays {{mana}} MP and starts {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast, including misses.

bone-spear.name: Bone Spear
bone-spear.desc: Hurls a bone spear at one living enemy for {{min}}–{{max}} Arcane base damage. Arcane resistance and magic resist mitigate the hit; armor (Defense) is ignored. Pays {{mana}} MP and starts {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast, including misses.

amplify-damage.name: Amplify Damage
amplify-damage.desc: Curses all living enemies, reducing physical resistance by {{reduction}} percentage points for {{duration}} at every skill rank.

decrepify.name: Decrepify
decrepify.desc: Curses all living enemies for {{duration}}, reducing AttackSpeed by {{slow}}% and outgoing direct damage by {{reduction}}% before resistance and flat mitigation. Existing damage-over-time rates stay unchanged; attack intervals follow the usual speed limits. Pays {{mana}} MP and starts a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Refreshes without stacking.

summon-mastery.name: Summon Mastery
summon-mastery.desc: Automatically grants newly created skeletons, skeletal mages, golems and revived minions +{{life}}% maximum life and +{{attack}}% Attack per allocated rank. Adds to local mastery bonuses. Necromancer only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave; existing summons stay unchanged.

poison-mastery.name: Poison and Bone Mastery
poison-mastery.desc: Automatically increases poison damage by {{poison}}% and arcane damage by {{arcane}}% per allocated rank. Necromancer only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave. Existing hit-derived poison damage over time includes the bonus once.

blood-golem.name: Blood Golem
blood-golem.desc: While this paid Blood Golem and its original owner are alive, your hero, mercenaries and summons recover their own life equal to {{percentOfDamage}}% of the hostile HP they remove, rounded down and capped by missing life. Includes direct, periodic and reflected damage from living sources. Misses, absorbed damage, overkill excess and self damage give no recovery. Multiple Blood Golems do not stack.

bone-armor.name: Bone Armor
bone-armor.desc: Automatic: gain {{absorb}} absorption per rank at the next fresh area run (character level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks). Your personal pool blocks direct and periodic damage after mitigation and does not refill between waves. Learning or upgrading applies to the next fresh area run. It does not heal or increase maximum life.

teeth.name: Teeth
teeth.desc: One independent attempt at each of the first two prioritized living enemies, dealing {{min}}–{{max}} Arcane base damage per target. Arcane resistance and magic resist mitigate each hit; Defense does not. Pays {{mana}} MP and starts {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast, including misses.

poison-dagger.name: Poison Dagger
poison-dagger.desc: One attempt at one prioritized living enemy, dealing {{min}}–{{max}} Poison base damage. Poison resistance and Defense mitigate the hit; magic resist does not. A hit adds one Poison stack. Pays {{mana}} MP and starts {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast, including misses. Misses apply no Poison.

bone-wall.name: Bone Wall
bone-wall.desc: Spend {{mana}} MP to create a personal barrier for {{duration}}, absorbing up to {{capacity}} hostile damage after mitigation, before Energy Shield and Bone Armor. Cooldown: {{cooldown}} s. Damage depletes the barrier; it neither stacks nor refreshes while active. It can be cast again after exhaustion or expiry and cooldown. Remaining capacity and time carry between waves.

poison-explosion.name: Poison Explosion
poison-explosion.desc: Requires an enemy monster to die in this wave first. Consumes one shared corpse and {{mana}} MP to deal {{min}}–{{max}} {{type}} damage to all remaining enemies. Hits apply {{poison}}; fresh {{poison}} lasts {{duration}}, up to {{stacks}} stacks. Reapplication refreshes the stack duration and retains the first damaging rate. Cooldown: {{cooldown}}. With no corpse, the combo skips this skill. Corpses clear between waves; consumption leaves normal kill rewards unchanged.

bone-prison.name: Bone Prison
bone-prison.desc: Spend {{mana}} MP to trap all living enemies for {{duration}} ({{bossDuration}} against bosses and chapter bosses), preventing scheduled actions and interrupting channels. Already-launched non-channel spells continue. Cooldown: {{cooldown}} s. Reapplication replaces the trap without stacking.

bone-spirit.name: Bone Spirit
bone-spirit.desc: Sends a seeking bone spirit at one living enemy for {{min}}–{{max}} Arcane base damage. Arcane resistance and magic resist mitigate the hit; Defense does not. The spirit can miss. Pays {{mana}} MP and starts {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast, including misses.

skeleton-mastery.name: Skeleton Mastery
skeleton-mastery.desc: Passive: Newly created skeleton warriors and mages gain +{{life}}% maximum life, +{{attack}}% Attack and +{{defense}}% ordinary Defense per allocated skill rank (up to +{{maxLife}}%/+{{maxAttack}}%/+{{maxDefense}}% at rank {{cap}}). Unlocks at character level {{level}}.

clay-golem.name: Clay Golem
clay-golem.desc: Summons a slow but durable clay golem.

golem-mastery.name: Golem Mastery
golem-mastery.desc: Passive: Newly created Clay, Blood, Iron and Fire Golems gain +{{life}}% maximum life and +{{speed}} flat Attack Speed per allocated skill rank (up to +{{maxLife}}% life and +{{maxSpeed}} Attack Speed at rank {{cap}}). Unlocks at character level {{level}}.

raise-skeletal-mage.name: Raise Skeletal Mage
raise-skeletal-mage.desc: Each fresh batch assigns mages Fire → Cold → Lightning → Poison, repeating from Fire. Basic attacks deal their assigned element; no corpse is required. Landed Fire bolts apply 3s Burn (10% of hit damage/s/stack, max 5); Cold applies 2s Chill (−50% Attack Speed); Lightning attempts 1s Paralyze (50% rejection if repeated within 5s); Poison applies 5s Poison (5% of hit damage/s/stack, max 10). Each damage-over-time status retains the first hit rate until it ends, rounded down to at least 1 damage/s per stack. Further Burn or Poison hits add stacks up to the cap and refresh the duration. On death, half the Poison stacks (rounded down, minimum 1) spread to other living enemies for 5s at the captured rate.

summon-resist.name: Summon Resist
summon-resist.desc: Automatically grants newly created skeletons, skeletal mages, golems and revived minions +{{resist}} percentage points to physical, fire, cold, lightning, arcane and poison resistance per allocated rank. Requires Golem Mastery and its Clay Golem prerequisite. Necromancer only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave; existing summons stay unchanged.

iron-golem.name: Iron Golem
iron-golem.desc: Sacrifice one explicitly chosen metal backpack item and 35 MP at a new wave start to prepare one Iron Golem for that wave. It inherits only the item’s Life, Attack and Defense.

fire-golem.name: Fire Golem
fire-golem.desc: Ordinary attacks deal Fire damage. Each landed hit applies Burn: {{percentOfHit}}% of the final hit per second per stack, rounded down with minimum {{minDps}} damage per second, for {{durationSeconds}} s, up to {{maxStacks}} stacks. Further hits add stacks up to the cap and refresh the duration.

revive.name: Revive
revive.desc: Prepare Revived Minions whose strength grows with skill rank. No corpse or fallen enemy is required. They last until they or their summoner die, or the wave ends.

dim-vision.name: Dim Vision
dim-vision.desc: Blinds all living enemies for {{duration}}, reducing Physical / thorns hit chance by {{penalty}} percentage points (5% minimum). Successful-hit damage, magical accuracy and existing damage-over-time rates stay unchanged. With Raven Blind, only the stronger penalty applies. Pays {{mana}} MP; {{cooldown}} s cooldown.

weaken.name: Weaken
weaken.desc: Curses all living enemies for {{duration}}, reducing outgoing direct damage by {{reduction}}% before resistance and flat mitigation. AttackSpeed and existing damage-over-time rates stay unchanged. Pays {{mana}} MP and starts a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Refreshes without stacking.

iron-maiden.name: Iron Maiden
iron-maiden.desc: Curses all living enemies for {{duration}}. When a cursed attacker removes Physical HP from an enemy, reflect {{percent}}% of Physical HP actually removed as Thorns, including lethal hits, before the attacker’s resistance and Defense. Absorbed damage, overkill, misses, damage-over-time and reflection add no reflected damage. Pays {{mana}} MP and starts a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Refreshes without stacking.

terror.name: Terror
terror.desc: Curses all living enemies with fear for {{duration}} ({{bossDuration}} against bosses and chapter bosses), preventing scheduled actions and interrupting channels. Pays {{mana}} MP and starts a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Refreshes without stacking.

confuse.name: Confuse
confuse.desc: Curses all living enemies for {{duration}}. Their new attacks target other living enemies still hostile to your party. Attract takes priority over Confuse. If no eligible enemy remains, ordinary targeting resumes. Your party and converted allies never turn against each other. Refreshes without stacking. Pays {{mana}} MP; {{cooldown}} s cooldown.

life-tap.name: Life Tap
life-tap.desc: Curses all living enemies for {{duration}}. After a direct hit removes HP from a cursed enemy, heal the surviving attacker for {{percent}}% of direct HP actually removed, rounded down and capped to missing HP. Settle retaliation first; lethal hits qualify, but dead attackers cannot revive. Absorbed damage and overkill add no healing. Damage-over-time and reflection do not heal. Pays {{mana}} MP and starts a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Refreshes without stacking.

attract.name: Attract
attract.desc: Curses one living enemy for {{duration}}. Other living enemies still hostile to your party target it with their new attacks. Attract takes priority over Confuse and Taunt. With several attracted enemies, the first other one in spawn order takes priority; a cursed enemy never targets itself. If no eligible bait remains, active Confuse applies; otherwise ordinary targeting resumes. Your party and converted allies never turn against each other. Refreshes without stacking. Pays {{mana}} MP; {{cooldown}} s cooldown.

lower-resist.name: Lower Resist
lower-resist.desc: Curses all living enemies for {{duration}}, reducing all six resistance pools, including Physical, by {{percent}} percentage points before resistance limits and flat mitigation. Adds with other resistance reductions; Thorns uses Physical resistance. Existing damage-over-time rates stay unchanged; new hit-derived rates use the modified hit. Pays {{mana}} MP and starts a {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Refreshes without stacking.

zeal.name: Zeal
zeal.desc: Deals {{min}} ~ {{max}} Physical base damage once to each of up to {{maxTargets}} living enemies in the densest cross. Ties choose the lowest row then column; take the first targets in row order, then column order. Each target has an independent hit and critical roll; misses and kills do not add replacement targets. One mana payment and cooldown per cast.

holy-bolt.name: Holy Bolt
holy-bolt.desc: Deals {{min}} ~ {{max}} Arcane base damage to one enemy. A surviving caster restores 50% of the actual direct HP removed.

blessed-hammer.name: Blessed Hammer
blessed-hammer.desc: Deals {{min}} ~ {{max}} Arcane base damage to all enemies, ignoring flat magic resist. Arcane percentage resistance, magic dodge, critical hits and shields still apply.

vengeance.name: Vengeance
vengeance.desc: One strike deals {{fireMin}} ~ {{fireMax}} Fire, {{coldMin}} ~ {{coldMax}} Cold and {{lightningMin}} ~ {{lightningMax}} Lightning base damage. The components share one hit and critical roll, with separate modifiers and mitigation. Fire applies Burn, Cold applies Chill for {{chillSeconds}} s and Lightning applies Paralyze for {{paralyzeSeconds}} s; repeated Paralyze can fail. A miss applies none.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: Deals {{min}} ~ {{max}} Physical base damage to one enemy. A landed hit applies Stun for {{duration}} (bosses: {{bossDuration}}). Your position stays the same. Misses apply no Stun.

fist-of-heavens.name: Fist of the Heavens
fist-of-heavens.desc: Deals {{min}} ~ {{max}} Lightning base damage once to every living enemy. A landed hit applies Paralyze for {{duration}}, including bosses. Misses apply no Paralyze. Repeated Paralyze can fail. One mana payment and cooldown per cast.

might.name: Might
might.desc: When selected, each rank grants you and your living fielded mercenary +{{physical}}% physical damage and +{{attack}}% Attack, up to +{{maxPhysical}}% and +{{maxAttack}}% at rank {{cap}}. Changes apply from the next wave.

holy-fire.name: Holy Fire
holy-fire.desc: Select for the next wave: while the hero lives, pulses every {{pulseSeconds}} second for {{pulseDamage}} base fire damage to all enemies. The first pulse waits a full interval. Pulses continue during stun or freeze, cost no mana and cannot miss or critically hit. Burn deals {{burnPct}}% of mitigated pulse damage per second per stack (rounded down, minimum 1) for {{burnSeconds}} seconds, up to {{burnMaxStacks}} stacks. Per rank, the hero and originally fielded living mercenary gain fire damage +{{fireDamagePct}}%. Requires level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks.

conviction.name: Conviction
conviction.desc: Select for the next wave: while the source hero lives, reduces all six enemy resistances by {{enemyResistReductionPct}} percentage points, including below zero. Allied summons also benefit from the enemy debuff. Per rank, the hero and originally fielded living mercenary gain elemental damage +{{elementalDamagePct}}% and arcane damage +{{arcaneDamagePct}}%. Requires level {{level}} and Sanctuary; maximum {{cap}} ranks.

meditation.name: Meditation
meditation.desc: Selected aura: adds {{bonus}}% of your normal mana regeneration per second per allocated rank to you and your living fielded mercenary (up to {{maxBonus}}% at rank {{cap}}). Each recipient retains their own normal recovery. Unlocks at character level {{level}}.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.desc: Deals {{min}} ~ {{max}} Physical base damage to one enemy. Costs no mana; a hit that removes enemy life also costs your life.

smite.name: Smite
smite.desc: Deals {{min}} ~ {{max}} Physical base damage to one enemy. A landed hit applies Stun for {{duration}} (bosses: {{bossDuration}}). Misses apply no Stun.

conversion.name: Conversion
conversion.desc: A paid hit that removes HP converts a surviving ordinary monster or rare minion for {{seconds}} seconds. It and its living summons fight former allies using their normal skills; elite monsters and bosses take damage only. Expiry restores hostility; source death ends conversion. No healing or stat change. Converted units keep their original enemy identity for victory, loot and corpses; conversion alone cannot clear an enemy. Misses, kills and fully absorbed hits do not convert.

holy-shield.name: Holy Shield
holy-shield.desc: Pay once to gain +{{defense}}% ordinary Defense and {{reduction}}% damage reduction per rank (up to {{maxReduction}}% at rank {{cap}}). Reduction applies after normal mitigation to hits, reflected damage and ongoing damage, rounded down cumulatively for ongoing damage. This v1 shield absorbs damage rather than rolling a separate block chance. No shield equipment is required. Lasts for this area run, carries across waves and does not heal or refill resources. Already active: no recast or payment. Rank changes apply next wave; losing class or prerequisites removes the effect. Fresh runs and imports start unpaid. Unlock level {{level}}.

blessed-aim.name: Blessed Aim
blessed-aim.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{attackPct}}% Attack to basic attacks and Attack-scaled skill damage.

concentration.name: Concentration
concentration.desc: Selected aura: while the hero lives, you and your living fielded mercenary gain physical damage +{{physicalDamagePct}}% per rank. Scheduled basic attacks and ready skills continue during Stun. Stun remains applied and expires normally; Freeze and Paralyze still block actions. Skills keep their normal mana and cooldown requirements. The aura spends no mana and grants no extra actions. Hero death ends protection. Changes apply next wave and never become permanent stats.

holy-freeze.name: Holy Freeze
holy-freeze.desc: Select for the next wave: while the source hero lives, chills every enemy, reducing Attack Speed by {{chillSlowPct}}%. Ordinary Chill and mercenary Holy Freeze share one slowdown. Per rank, the hero and originally fielded living mercenary gain cold damage +{{coldDamagePct}}% and Physical Dodge +{{physDodgePct}} percentage points. Requires level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. A mercenary aura grants its separate party cold bonus.

holy-shock.name: Holy Shock
holy-shock.desc: Select for the next wave: while the hero lives, pulses every {{pulseSeconds}} second for {{pulseDamage}} base lightning damage to all enemies. The first pulse waits a full interval. Pulses continue during stun or freeze, cost no mana and cannot miss or critically hit. Per rank, the hero and originally fielded living mercenary gain lightning damage +{{lightningDamagePct}}%. Requires level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.desc: Selected aura: while the hero lives, you and your living fielded mercenary gain arcane damage +{{arcaneDamagePct}}% per rank. Every {{sanctuarySeconds}} seconds, the hero deals {{sanctuaryDamage}} base Arcane damage to living undead enemies only, then stuns survivors for {{repulseMs}} ms (bosses: {{bossRepulseMs}} ms). Repulsion is a short Stun with no movement. Pulses use normal mitigation, cannot crit or be dodged, and spend no mana. The first pulse waits one full interval after wave entry; hero death stops future pulses. Changes apply next wave and never become permanent stats.

fanaticism.name: Fanaticism
fanaticism.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{physicalDamagePct}}% physical damage and +{{attackSpeedPct}}% attack speed.

prayer.name: Prayer
prayer.desc: Selected aura: restores {{healAmount}} base HP every {{healSeconds}} seconds to you and your living fielded mercenary, first heal after {{healSeconds}} seconds of each wave. Healing gains +{{lifeRegenPct}}% per rank, is rounded down and capped to missing HP. Requires a living hero; never revives dead allies. Unlocks at character level {{level}}, rank cap {{cap}}.

resist-fire.name: Resist Fire
resist-fire.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{resistAllPct}} percentage point to all six resistances and +{{fireDamagePct}}% fire damage.

defiance.name: Defiance
defiance.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{defensePct}}% Defense before enemy defense reductions.

resist-cold.name: Resist Cold
resist-cold.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{resistAllPct}} percentage point to all six resistances and +{{coldDamagePct}}% cold damage.

cleansing.name: Cleansing
cleansing.desc: Selected aura: reduces finite Poison, Plague and curse durations (including Amplify Damage) by {{durationReductionPct}}% once when applied or first entering a wave. Permanent effects are unchanged; shortened durations stay shortened after the aura ends. While the hero lives, you and your living fielded mercenary gain Magical Dodge +{{magicDodgePct}} percentage point per rank and restore {{healAmount}} base HP every {{healSeconds}} seconds, first heal after {{healSeconds}} seconds of each wave. Healing gains +{{lifeRegenPct}}% per rank, rounded down and capped to missing HP; never revives.

resist-lightning.name: Resist Lightning
resist-lightning.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{resistAllPct}} percentage point to all six resistances and +{{lightningDamagePct}}% lightning damage.

vigor.name: Vigor
vigor.desc: Selected aura: while the hero lives, you and your living fielded mercenary gain maximum life +{{lifePct}}% and Attack Speed +{{attackSpeedPct}}% per rank. The extra life capacity is rounded down over the fresh maximum; selecting or upgrading this aura does not heal. Existing healing and HP orbs can fill the extra capacity. When the aura ends, current HP is capped to the base maximum. Bonuses apply at the next wave and never become permanent stats.

redemption.name: Redemption
redemption.desc: Selected aura: every {{redemptionSeconds}} seconds, consumes one corpse from this wave to restore {{redemptionLife}} base HP and {{redemptionMana}} base MP to you and your living fielded mercenary while the hero lives. HP recovery +{{lifeRegenPct}}% per rank and MP recovery +{{manaRegenPct}}% per rank, rounded down and capped to missing resources. First pulse after {{redemptionSeconds}} seconds of each wave. If nobody can recover, including full resources, the corpse is preserved. Healing never revives dead allies. Competes with Corpse Explosion and Poison Explosion; no extra cast or mana cost.

salvation.name: Salvation
salvation.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{resistAllPct}} percentage points to all six resistances and +{{elementalDamagePct}}% fire, cold and lightning damage.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.desc: Selected aura: each rank reflects {{thornsPct}}% of physical Life actually lost by a surviving recipient. Reflection is mitigated as thorns and cannot reflect again.

ice-bolt.name: Ice Bolt
ice-bolt.desc: One single-target Cold attempt deals {{min}}–{{max}} Cold base damage. A landed hit applies Chill for {{chill}}, reducing Attack Speed by {{slow}}%. Misses apply no Chill. Pay {{mana}} MP and start the {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast.

frost-nova.name: Frost Nova
frost-nova.desc: One independent attempt per living enemy deals {{min}}–{{max}} Cold base damage. Landed hits apply Chill for {{chill}}, reducing Attack Speed by {{slow}}%, then independently have a {{freezeChance}}% chance of Freeze for {{freeze}} (bosses: {{bossFreeze}}). Misses apply no Chill or Freeze. Pay {{mana}} MP and start the {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast.

frozen-orb.name: Frozen Orb
frozen-orb.desc: The cone covers one apex cell and three adjacent cells in the next row. Choose the most enemies, breaking ties by foremost row then leftmost column. Each selected enemy receives one independent attempt for {{min}}–{{max}} Cold base damage. A landed hit applies Chill for {{chill}}, reducing Attack Speed by {{slow}}%. Misses apply no Chill. Pay {{mana}} MP and start the {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast. Cold resistance and Magic Resist apply.

chain-lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain-lightning.desc: Bounces between up to {{maxTargets}} distinct living enemies, starting with the first prioritized enemy and then the nearest unvisited enemy. Each takes one attempt for {{min}}–{{max}} Lightning base damage. Misses and lethal hits do not stop the chain. Pay {{mana}} MP and start a {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast. Lightning resistance and magic resist apply. A fresh landed hit applies Paralyze for {{duration}}, including bosses. Reapplication during its 5 s residual window has a 50% chance to succeed. Misses apply no Paralyze.

fire-ball.name: Fire Ball
fire-ball.desc: One single-target attempt explodes on the target for {{min}}–{{max}} Fire base damage. Pay {{mana}} MP and start a {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast. A landed hit applies Burn. Misses apply no Burn. Fire resistance and Defense apply.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.desc: A meteor deals {{min}}–{{max}} {{type}} damage over an area. On a successful hit, applies {{burn}} then {{melt}}. {{melt}} reduces ordinary Defense by {{reduction}}% for {{duration}} at every skill rank. One independent attempt per living enemy, including separated and overflow targets. Pay {{mana}} MP and start a {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast. Misses apply no Burn or Armor Melt. Fire resistance and Defense apply to the initial hit before Armor Melt.

cold-mastery.name: Cold Mastery
cold-mastery.desc: Passive: Your direct cold hits ignore {{base}} percentage points of enemy cold resistance at rank 1, plus {{growth}} per additional rank ({{max}} at rank {{cap}}). Unlocks at character level {{level}}. Applies only to you.

lightning-mastery.name: Lightning Mastery
lightning-mastery.desc: Passive: +{{bonus}}% direct lightning damage per allocated skill rank (up to +{{maxBonus}}% at rank {{cap}}). Unlocks at character level {{level}}. Paralyze is unchanged.

fire-mastery.name: Fire Mastery
fire-mastery.desc: Passive: +4% fire damage per allocated skill rank (up to +80% at rank 20). Unlocks at character level 30 and adds to Warmth’s fire bonus.

energy-shield.name: Energy Shield
energy-shield.desc: Automatic, personal: divert {{absorb}}% of mitigated damage per rank (up to {{maxAbsorb}}% at rank {{cap}}), paying 1 MP per prevented HP. Whole-point diversion is limited by available mana; the rest damages life. Also +{{recovery}}% ordinary Energy-based mana recovery per rank; maximum MP does not increase. Unlocks at character level {{level}} after Telekinesis and Teleport. Learning, upgrading or resetting applies next wave; it neither casts nor refills resources.

frozen-armor.name: Frozen Armor
frozen-armor.desc: Surrounds the caster with a freezing shield that chills attackers.

ice-blast.name: Ice Blast
ice-blast.desc: Releases a shard of ice that damages and chills the target.

shiver-armor.name: Shiver Armor
shiver-armor.desc: Costs {{mana}} MP; {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Until this run ends: +{{defense}}% Defense and +{{bonus}}% direct Cold damage. Each landed direct Physical hit attempts a counter for {{min}}–{{max}} Cold base damage. Landed counters apply Freeze for {{seconds}} s (bosses: {{bossSeconds}} s). Missed counters do not Freeze. Cold resistance, magic resist and shields mitigate counters. Periodic damage and other counters do not trigger retaliation. Cast once; can coexist with other ice armors.

glacial-spike.name: Glacial Spike
glacial-spike.desc: Hurls a massive icicle that freezes targets in an area.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.desc: One independent attempt per living enemy deals {{min}}–{{max}} Cold base damage. A landed hit applies Chill for {{chill}}, reducing Attack Speed by {{slow}}%. Misses apply no Chill. Pay {{mana}} MP and start the {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast.

chilling-armor.name: Chilling Armor
chilling-armor.desc: Costs {{mana}} MP; {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Until this run ends: +{{defense}}% Defense and +{{bonus}} percentage points of magic dodge. Each landed direct hostile hit attempts a counter for {{min}}–{{max}} Cold base damage. Landed counters apply Freeze for {{seconds}} s (bosses: {{bossSeconds}} s). Missed counters do not Freeze. Cold resistance, magic resist and shields mitigate counters. Periodic damage and other counters do not trigger retaliation. Cast once; can coexist with other ice armors.

charged-bolt.name: Charged Bolt
charged-bolt.desc: One bolt attempt at each of the first two prioritized living enemies deals {{min}}–{{max}} Lightning base damage per enemy. Pay {{mana}} MP and start a {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast. Lightning resistance and magic resist apply.

static-field.name: Static Field
static-field.desc: Weakens all enemies with lightning based on their current health. Lightning resistance and magic resist reduce the damage. Cannot kill; follow with another attack. At the health floor, yields to the next available skill. Higher ranks reduce mana cost and cooldown.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.desc: Interrupt one enemy with Stun for {{duration}} (bosses: {{bossDuration}}), without moving it. Costs {{mana}} MP; {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Deals no damage and does not manipulate world objects. Higher ranks reduce mana cost and cooldown. Changes during combat apply next wave.

nova.name: Nova
nova.desc: One independent attempt per living enemy, including separated and overflow targets, deals {{min}}–{{max}} Lightning base damage. Pay {{mana}} MP and start a {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast. Lightning resistance and magic resist apply.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.desc: One single-target attempt deals {{min}}–{{max}} Lightning base damage. Pay {{mana}} MP and start a {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast. Lightning resistance and magic resist apply.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.desc: Gain +{{points}} percentage points of magical dodge for {{duration}}, without moving. Costs {{mana}} MP; {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Physical attacks and existing damage over time are unchanged. Cannot recast while active; can coexist with Enchant. Changes during combat apply next wave.

thunder-storm.name: Thunder Storm
thunder-storm.desc: Call a lightning storm for {{duration}} s. Deal {{min}}–{{max}} Lightning base damage per pulse to all living enemies, immediately then every {{interval}} s ({{pulses}} pulses). Pay {{mana}} MP and start a {{cooldown}} s cooldown in one payment. The spell continues through Stun/Freeze and stops on death; cannot recast while active. Landed hits attempt Paralyze for 1 s (bosses: 0.5 s); recent Paralyze has a 50% reapplication chance. Lightning resistance and magic resist apply.

fire-bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire-bolt.desc: One single-target attempt deals {{min}}–{{max}} Fire base damage. Pay {{mana}} MP and start a {{cooldown}} s cooldown once per cast. A landed hit applies Burn. Misses apply no Burn. Fire resistance and Defense apply.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.desc: Channel a flame stream for {{duration}} s. Each pulse selects a two-row cone (one cell, then three cells) and attempts {{min}}–{{max}} Fire base damage per enemy, immediately then every {{interval}} s ({{pulses}} pulses). Pay {{mana}} MP and start a {{cooldown}} s cooldown in one payment. Caster actions are occupied while channeling. Stun, Freeze, Paralyze or Fear interrupts without a refund; Concentration protects against Stun only. Death stops the stream; cannot recast while active. Landed hits apply Burn for 3 s, up to 5 stacks, each dealing 10% of that hit per second (minimum 1). Fire resistance and Defense apply. Remaining time and paid rank carry into the next wave while learned; new allocations govern future casts.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.desc: Establish a fire trail for {{duration}} s. Deal {{min}}–{{max}} Fire base damage per pulse to all living enemies, immediately then every {{interval}} s ({{pulses}} pulses). Pay {{mana}} MP and start a {{cooldown}} s cooldown in one payment. The spell continues through Stun/Freeze and stops on death; cannot recast while active. Landed hits apply Burn for 3 s, up to 5 stacks, with each stack dealing 10% of that hit per second (minimum 1). Fire resistance and Defense apply.

fire-wall.name: Fire Wall
fire-wall.desc: Raise a fire wall for {{duration}} s. Deal {{min}}–{{max}} Fire base damage per pulse to all living enemies, immediately then every {{interval}} s ({{pulses}} pulses). Pay {{mana}} MP and start a {{cooldown}} s cooldown in one payment. The spell continues through Stun/Freeze and stops on death; cannot recast while active. Landed hits apply Burn for 3 s, up to 5 stacks, with each stack dealing 10% of that hit per second (minimum 1). Fire resistance and Defense apply.

enchant.name: Enchant
enchant.desc: Capture Attack and skill rank when cast. For {{duration}}, each later hostile direct Physical hit adds Fire base damage equal to {{percent}}% of Attack, with a shared hit and critical roll. Costs {{mana}} MP; {{cooldown}} s cooldown. Fire resistance and Defense apply; no Burn or spell bonus. Cannot recast while active; can coexist with Teleport. The paid snapshot carries between waves; changes during combat affect future casts from the next wave.

hydra.name: Hydra
hydra.desc: When each wave starts, pay {{mana}} MP once to prepare one targetable body for {{duration}} s ({{cooldown}} s cooldown). Each own scheduled action attempts {{heads}} separate bolts, each dealing {{min}}–{{max}} Fire base damage; after a kill, the next head selects another living enemy. There is no instant caster damage. Fire resistance and Defense apply; landed bolts apply ordinary Burn. The paid rank and your Fire damage bonus are captured at preparation. Body control blocks its actions; owner control does not. Expiry, body death or owner death stops attacks; no same-wave retry, replacement or refund. The next wave prepares again using carried mana.

weak-melee.name: Weak Melee
weak-melee.desc: A clumsy melee swing used by trash mobs.

strong-melee.name: Strong Melee
strong-melee.desc: A powerful melee strike used by elites and bosses.

fire-breath.name: Fire Breath
fire-breath.desc: A cone of flame breathed at the party, burning targets.

poison-spit.name: Poison Spit
poison-spit.desc: Spits venom at a single target, applying 2 stacks of poison.

lightning-bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning-bolt.desc: Hurls a bolt of lightning at a single target.

frost-aura.name: Frost Aura
frost-aura.desc: An aura of cold that chills all nearby enemies each turn.

monster-charge.name: Charge
monster-charge.desc: A boss ability: charges a target for heavy physical damage.

blood-raven-raise-dead.name: Raise Dead
blood-raven-raise-dead.desc: Raises 3 Zombies every 25 seconds, up to 6 living Zombies.

blood-raven-fire-arrow.name: Fire Arrow
blood-raven-fire-arrow.desc: Deals 35–55 fire damage and applies 2 Burn stacks for 3 seconds.

summon-adds.name: Summon Minions
summon-adds.desc: Summons 2 trash minions to aid the boss.

heal.name: Heal
heal.desc: Restores 30% of the caster's max HP.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.desc: Teleports to a new position, gaining +50% dodge for 1 turn.

ice-shard.name: Ice Shard
ice-shard.desc: Hurls a shard of ice at a single target, chilling them.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.desc: Bathes all enemies in fire over time.

thunder-storm.name: Thunder Storm
thunder-storm.desc: Calls down lightning bolts on all enemies.

poison-cloud.name: Poison Cloud
poison-cloud.desc: Releases a cloud of toxic gas that poisons all enemies.

arcane-bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
arcane-bolt.desc: Fires a bolt of arcane energy at a single target.

rend.name: Rend
rend.desc: A vicious melee tear that causes the target to bleed.

frozen-orb.name: Frozen Orb
frozen-orb.desc: Hurls a frozen orb that hits all enemies.

leap.name: Leap
leap.desc: Leaps and crashes down on all enemies, stunning briefly.

enrage.name: Enrage
enrage.desc: Boss enrages, gaining +50% damage for 5 turns.

thorns-aura.name: Thorns Aura
thorns-aura.desc: Reflects a portion of melee damage taken back to attackers.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: A boss ability: charges a target for heavy physical damage.

panic-flee.name: Panic Flee
panic-flee.desc: The Fallen panics and flees in fear, granting itself extra dodge for a turn.

weak-ranged.name: Weak Ranged
weak-ranged.desc: A weak ranged attack used by trash archers and shooters.

fire-bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire-bolt.desc: Hurls a small bolt of fire at one target.

frost-bolt.name: Frost Bolt
frost-bolt.desc: Hurls a bolt of cold that chills its target.

fire-arrow.name: Fire Arrow
fire-arrow.desc: Looses a flaming arrow at a single target, igniting them.

poison-dagger.name: Poison Dagger
poison-dagger.desc: A vicious dagger thrust laced with toxin.

fire-ball.name: Fire Ball
fire-ball.desc: A small explosion of fire that scorches all nearby enemies.

frost-nova.name: Frost Nova
frost-nova.desc: A circle of frost erupts outward, chilling all enemies.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.desc: Hurls a bolt of lightning that arcs through enemies.

corpse-explosion.name: Corpse Explosion
corpse-explosion.desc: Detonates a nearby corpse for area physical and fire damage.

bone-spirit.name: Bone Spirit
bone-spirit.desc: A homing bone spirit that seeks the most wounded foe.

bone-prison.name: Bone Prison
bone-prison.desc: Encases the target in a bone cage, preventing dodge.

leap-attack.name: Leap Attack
leap-attack.desc: Leaps onto a target and crashes down for heavy physical damage.

war-cry.name: War Cry
war-cry.desc: A thunderous shout that stuns nearby foes.

shout.name: Shout
shout.desc: A rallying barbarian shout that increases the caster's defense.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: Spins through enemies, striking everyone in melee range.

curse.name: Curse
curse.desc: A vile curse that amplifies damage taken by the target.

mana-rift.name: Mana Rift
mana-rift.desc: Tears open a rift that drains the target's mana and burns them.

tentacles.name: Festering Tentacles
tentacles.desc: Summons writhing tentacles that lash all enemies.

plague-spit.name: Plague Spit
plague-spit.desc: Spits a globule of plague that poisons enemies.

jab.name: Jab
jab.desc: A rapid spear thrust used by Desert Mercs.

bash.name: Bash
bash.desc: A heavy weapon swing that can stun.

smite.name: Smite
smite.desc: Bashes the foe with the shield, briefly stunning.

chop.name: Chop
chop.desc: A militia swordsman's basic chopping strike.

pierce-thrust.name: Pierce Thrust
pierce-thrust.desc: A long pike thrust that pierces armor.

basic-swing.name: Basic Swing
basic-swing.desc: A barbarian recruit's basic two-handed swing.

pilfer.name: Pilfer
pilfer.desc: A rogue's quick stab with a chance to steal gold.

basic-arrow.name: Basic Arrow
basic-arrow.desc: Deals 16–26 physical damage plus 100% of the mercenary's Attack to one enemy. Cooldown: 1s. Costs no mana.

fire-arrow.name: Fire Arrow
fire-arrow.desc: A flaming arrow that ignites its target.

cold-arrow.name: Cold Arrow
cold-arrow.desc: A frost-tipped arrow that chills its target.

pierce-arrow.name: Pierce Arrow
pierce-arrow.desc: Deals 26–42 physical damage plus 100% of the mercenary's Attack to every enemy. Cooldown: 3s. Costs no mana.

inner-sight.name: Inner Sight
inner-sight.desc: Reveals weak points on enemies, lowering their defense.

fire-ball.name: Fire Ball
fire-ball.desc: An Iron Wolf's signature explosion of fire.

glacial-spike.name: Glacial Spike
glacial-spike.desc: Hurls a frozen spike that freezes its target.

charged-bolt.name: Charged Bolt
charged-bolt.desc: Fires erratic lightning bolts at random enemies.

frozen-armor.name: Frozen Armor
frozen-armor.desc: Wraps the caster in icy armor that chills attackers.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.desc: A telekinetic shove that knocks foes back.

war-cry.name: War Cry
war-cry.desc: A barbarian shout that stuns foes and rallies allies.

holy-fire.name: Holy Fire Strike
holy-fire.desc: A paladin attack imbued with holy fire damage.

minor-heal.name: Minor Heal
minor-heal.desc: An acolyte's healing prayer that restores ally life.

holy-freeze.name: Holy Freeze Aura
holy-freeze.desc: While the mercenary lives, Chill reduces every enemy's Attack Speed by 50% and the party gains +20% increased cold damage.

might.name: Might Aura
might.desc: An aura that increases physical damage of allies.

thorns.name: Thorns Aura
thorns.desc: Reflects a portion of melee damage to attackers.

prayer.name: Prayer Aura
prayer.desc: Slowly regenerates the life of nearby allies.

blessed-aim.name: Blessed Aim Aura
blessed-aim.desc: Increases the attack rating of allies.

defiance.name: Defiance Aura
defiance.desc: Increases the defense of nearby allies.

battle-orders.name: Battle Orders
battle-orders.desc: A barbarian war shout that boosts ally life and mana.

fire-mastery.name: Fire Mastery
fire-mastery.desc: Passive: increases fire damage dealt by the caster.

critical.name: Critical Strike
critical.desc: Passive: chance to deal double damage on hit.

ironGolem.title: Iron Golem sacrifice
ironGolem.rules: The golem expires at wave end. It inherits only the chosen item's Life, Attack and Defense, without set combination bonuses.
ironGolem.timing: Arming does not reserve or consume the item. Moving, equipping or discarding it may invalidate the instruction. Loading a save clears the instruction.
ironGolem.acknowledge: I understand: if Iron Golem prepares successfully in the next new wave, this item will be permanently consumed.
ironGolem.notArmed: No item armed for the next new wave.
ironGolem.armedInvalid: The armed instruction is no longer eligible: {{reason}}
ironGolem.previewScope: Current and next totals include this item once, then current eligible Golem Mastery. Attack Speed is flat. These live previews can differ from the recorded attempt and do not guarantee preparation or payment.
ironGolem.configurationUnavailable: Learn Iron Golem and its prerequisite, meet its level requirement, and add it to Active Skill Priority before arming.
ironGolem.armDone: Instruction armed. The item has not been consumed.
ironGolem.noAttempt: No recorded attempt for this hero.
ironGolem.summoned: {{item}} was sacrificed to prepare Iron Golem for this recording ({{mana}} MP).
ironGolem.notPrepared: Iron Golem was not prepared in this recording. No sacrifice was charged for this attempt.
ironGolem.unverified: The sacrifice outcome is unverified. Review the recovery controls in Combat.
ironGolem.pendingPaid: {{item}} was sacrificed ({{mana}} MP); the recorded wave still needs publication. Review Combat recovery controls.
ironGolem.pendingNoDebit: The recorded wave still needs publication. This attempt has no additional item debit. Review Combat recovery controls.
ironGolem.replay: This is a replay; it consumes no additional sacrifice.
ironGolem.locked: This wave keeps its original Iron Golem result. Skill, rank, equipment and item changes apply from the next new wave.
ironGolem.unlocked: Iron Golem added now waits for the next new wave; replaying this wave cannot add a sacrifice.
